ingest.note: Receives transcribed text from STT. Streaming chat completions API.

egress.note: Streams text tokens to TTS. Use stream=True for low-latency first-token.

interruption.description: On interruption, cancel the in-flight streaming completion. Discard buffered tokens that haven't reached TTS yet.
interruption.code_hint: Pipecat: LLMContextAggregator handles this automatically via InterruptionFrame. LiveKit: session handles cancellation. Custom: call response.close() on the stream.

potholes.note: GPT-4o has a 128k context window. For long calls (>30 min), implement conversation summarization or sliding window to avoid truncation.
Tool calls pause audio output until the tool returns. Set a timeout (e.g. 5s) and respond with 'let me check that' if the tool is slow.

cost_estimates.notes: Est. ~250 tokens/min at GPT-5.5 pricing ($3/1M in, $15/1M out)
